product-except-self.python:
def solve(nums):
    n = len(nums)
    res = [1] * n
    pre = 1
    for i in range(n):
        res[i] = pre
        pre *= nums[i]
    suf = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        res[i] *= suf
        suf *= nums[i]
    return res

two-sum-sorted.python:
def solve(nums, target):
    l, r = 0, len(nums) - 1
    while l < r:
        s = nums[l] + nums[r]
        if s == target: return [l + 1, r + 1]
        if s < target: l += 1
        else: r -= 1
    return [-1]

cycle-start-index.python:
class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, v): self.val = v; self.next = None
def build_list(a):
    dummy = ListNode(0); t = dummy
    for x in a: t.next = ListNode(x); t = t.next
    return dummy.next
def ser_list(h):
    o = []
    while h: o.append(h.val); h = h.next
    return o
def build_cycle(a, pos):
    dummy = ListNode(0); t = dummy; cyc = None
    for i, x in enumerate(a):
        t.next = ListNode(x); t = t.next
        if i == pos: cyc = t
    if pos >= 0 and t: t.next = cyc
    return dummy.next
def solve(vals, pos):
    head=build_cycle(vals,pos); slow=head; fast=head; cyc=False
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow=slow.next; fast=fast.next.next
        if slow is fast: cyc=True; break
    if not cyc: return -1
    slow=head
    while slow is not fast:
        slow=slow.next; fast=fast.next
    i=0; n=head
    while n is not slow: n=n.next; i+=1
    return i

ugly-number-ii.python:
def solve(n):
    dp=[1]*n; i2=i3=i5=0
    for i in range(1,n):
        nx=min(dp[i2]*2, dp[i3]*3, dp[i5]*5); dp[i]=nx
        if nx==dp[i2]*2: i2+=1
        if nx==dp[i3]*3: i3+=1
        if nx==dp[i5]*5: i5+=1
    return dp[n-1]

graph-valid-tree.python:
def solve(n, u, v):
    if len(u)!=n-1: return False
    p=list(range(n))
    def f(x):
        while p[x]!=x: p[x]=p[p[x]]; x=p[x]
        return x
    cnt=n
    for a,b in zip(u,v):
        ra,rb=f(a),f(b)
        if ra==rb: return False
        p[ra]=rb; cnt-=1
    return cnt==1
